propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1M context windows in MODEL_LADDER, making sonnet-to-opus escalation a no-op that repeats the same context-limit failure at higher cost.

Context-limit retry logic cannot distinguish between a failed escalation and a successful one when both rungs have equal windows, masking the defect and misleading operators into believing even the largest model cannot fit the input.

The fix must filter escalation candidates through a new escalation_rungs() function that skips rungs offering no strict capacity increase, while leaving models_at_or_above() and MODEL_LADDER contents unchanged to preserve task 7761 regression coverage.

Both pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to prevent the guaranteed-failing paid opus call on sonnet-primary context-limit errors.
